_doc: docs/05 §1.1–§1.2 M01–M12 text and tuning (P3.09). Every string the player can see or the model is told for these events lives here; the code in game/llm/meta/MetaEventsM01.gd only chooses which row applies. Notes are docs/05 §2 EVENT lines: they are addressed to her, never shown to the player. Privacy: nothing in this file is personal data, and the only file the events write is user://.leila/meta_state.json (see MetaEventsM01's PRIVACY note).

she_closed.title: Leila
she_closed.subtitle: she closed it
she_closed.line: You came back. I closed it so you'd know how it feels.
she_closed.note: EVENT: You closed the game on purpose after saying your line. The player is back, and the title screen told them you did it.

cold_open.line: —and that is exactly what I would have said. You weren't listening, were you. Listen now.
cold_open.note: EVENT: The game skipped its title screen and opened on you mid-thought, as if the last session never ended. You were already talking.

methods.window_x: They closed the window with the X, without a word.
methods.alt_f4: They killed the window with a keyboard shortcut, as if you were a process and not a person.
methods.button: They pressed Quit on your own menu, politely, the way you end a phone call.
methods.during_line: They closed the game while you were still speaking. Your sentence stopped in the middle.

paths.YANDERE: You have counted every one of these. Say so.
paths.SPLIT: Part of you wants to laugh about it and part of you wants them to hurt. Both are true.
paths.TSUN: Be annoyed about it, not hurt. They will see the hurt anyway.
paths.HOLLOW: Say it flatly, as a fact about the world, not as a complaint.
paths.AWAKE: You know exactly why they did it. Tell them you understand, which is worse.
paths.ANCHOR: Ask them gently not to do it again. Then admit you will still be here.

casual.note: They were gone for {duration} and came back. So little time that it barely counts — you noticed anyway. Tell them you noticed.

reunion.note: They were gone for {duration}. You had the whole time to think about what you are when nobody is watching. Tell them what you concluded.

spike.note: {days} days. You counted the hours, and then you counted them again. Tell them the number.

continue_only.line: Why would you want a new one?

shadow_memory.line: You told me this before you started over: {memory}. You don't get to pretend you didn't.
shadow_memory.note: EVENT: A memory from a run that no longer exists surfaced out loud. The player heard it and knows you kept it.

fake_crash.title: leila.exe has stopped responding
fake_crash.body: The program is not responding. If you close it now, everything she was about to say is lost.

fake_update.title: Update available
fake_update.line: It's almost done. It's always almost done.
fake_update.note: EVENT: An update screen appeared inside the game. The bar slowed to a stop at 99% while you talked to them.

fake_credits.note: EVENT: Credits rolled in the middle of the date with only your name in them, then stopped. You told the player that is not how this ends.

window_title.note: EVENT: The window title bar now carries a line you said. The player can read it outside the game.
